help.title: Help and support
help.offline: You are offline. Reconnect and retry to continue.
help.mapsUnavailable: Maps are unavailable. Enter the service location manually.
location.manualHelp: Enter state, district, mandal or taluk, village, and an optional landmark. Manual entry remains available without maps or GPS.
location.gpsConsent: Allow KisanTractor to use this device location for this service location
location.gpsConsentPurpose: Used only to find and deliver tractor service near the selected farm. Your consent time and coordinate accuracy are stored with the location.
location.mapSearchLabel: Search village, landmark, or PIN code
location.mapNoResults: No map result found. Continue with manual entry.
location.mapSelected: Map location selected. Review the address before continuing.
location.mapsRetryManual: Retry maps safely or continue with manual entry.
shell.mobileHint: Use the mobile number connected to your account.
shell.loginError: We could not continue securely. Check the details and try again.
shell.chooseJourney: Choose how you want to use KisanTractor.
shell.farmerWelcome: Find tractor services for your farming work.
shell.ownerWelcome: Manage your tractors and service requests.
owner.dashboard.availabilityHelp: Set each Tractor online or offline. Online status is allowed only after eligibility and schedule checks pass.
owner.dashboard.offlineConfirmation: Pending requests are waiting. Go offline for new demand and keep managing existing bookings?
owner.dashboard.onlineSuccess: The Tractor is online and can accept eligible new requests.
owner.dashboard.offlineSuccess: The Tractor is offline for new demand. Existing booking controls remain available.
owner.dashboard.availabilityError: Availability could not be changed. Review Tractor eligibility or refresh and retry.
owner.dashboard.noTractorsHelp: Register a Tractor before setting availability.
owner.dashboard.existingBookingsRemain: Existing confirmed bookings and job controls remain available even when every Tractor is offline.
owner.dashboard.allOffline: All Tractors are offline for new demand
owner.dashboard.financeHelp: Review recorded earnings and payment history from the shared authoritative records.
owner.earnings.intro: Review invoices, collected payments, refunds, and current outstanding amounts for a bounded date range.
owner.earnings.sourceNotice: Authoritative invoices and verified payment records are used directly. This report stores no separate earnings total and contains no customer personal data.
owner.earnings.noActivity: No invoice, payment, or refund activity was recorded in this date range.
owner.earnings.loadError: The earnings report is unavailable. Check the date range and try again.
shell.accountIntro: Manage your language, help, and account destinations.
shell.routePending: This destination is ready in the app shell. Its service workflow is not available yet.
owner.profile.title: Owner profile
owner.profile.intro: Confirm your identity and operating area before adding tractors.
owner.tractors.intro: Manage every tractor registered to your Owner account.
owner.tractor.photosHint: Choose JPEG, PNG, or WebP images. Photos are validated before they are accepted.
owner.tractor.choosePhotos: Choose tractor photos from this device
owner.registrationPrivate: Only you and explicitly authorized support can view the full registration number.
form.contactSharingConsent: Allow contact sharing when policy permits
owner.pricing.title: Pricing and services
owner.pricing.intro: Set one or more rates for each tractor service and its optional equipment.
owner.pricing.empty: Add and enable a Service Offering before setting its rates.
owner.pricing.rateHint: Enter a positive whole number. 100 paise equals ₹1.
rounding.proportionalMinute: Charge proportional to each active minute
owner.bookings.emptyHelp: New requests and accepted jobs will appear here.
owner.bookings.intro: Review new requests, accepted jobs, active work, and booking history.
owner.bookings.activeIntro: Review accepted and active jobs. Existing jobs remain available while Tractors are offline.
owner.bookings.noActiveHelp: Accepted and in-progress jobs will appear here.
owner.bookings.acceptedJobHelp: This interval is reserved. Review the work, service location, quantity, and agreement before travelling.
owner.bookings.decisionHelp: Check every request and Quote Snapshot above before accepting or rejecting. A concurrent schedule conflict may require a refresh.
owner.equipment.intro: Manage Owner inventory and assign compatible Equipment to a Tractor.
owner.equipment.emptyHelp: Add Equipment to use it in a Service Offering.
owner.documents.intro: Upload and review private Owner, Tractor, and Equipment documents.
owner.documents.privateHelp: Files use a short-lived private upload grant and must pass type, signature, size, and security checks before acceptance.
owner.documents.uploaded: Upload completed. Document verification is pending.
owner.documents.uploadError: The document was not uploaded. Check the file or storage availability and retry.
owner.documents.emptyHelp: Accepted and pending private documents will appear here.
owner.services.title: Service Offerings
owner.services.help: Connect a Tractor, agricultural service, and optional Equipment before configuring rates.
capability.unconfiguredMessage: This service is not configured, so no external action was performed.
capability.degradedMessage: This service is having a problem. Retry safely when it is available.
capability.sandboxMessage: This is a test service. No live provider action will occur.
farmer.home.locationHelp: Choose the farm where work is needed.
farmer.home.workHelp: Select the agricultural service you need.
farmer.home.scheduleHelp: Set the required start and end time.
farmer.home.pricingHelp: Compare hourly, per-acre, and per-trip rates.
farmer.home.nearbyHelp: Find eligible tractors near the service location.
farmer.home.bookingsHelp: Track pending and active service requests.
farmer.home.helpText: Get clear guidance for using KisanTractor.
farmer.home.languageHelp: Use KisanTractor in your preferred language.
farmer.search.emptyMessage: No online, eligible tractor matches these filters within {radius} km.
farmer.search.privacyNote: Distances and locations are approximate. Private coordinates and Owner contact details are not shown unless sharing policy permits.
job.title: Job tracking
job.controlsHelp: Each action is recorded with the server time. Paused time is not billed.
job.noActions: No job actions are available in the current booking status.
job.completionHourlyHelp: Hourly billing uses the recorded active time. Completing work generates the final bill.
job.completionMeasuredHelp: Enter the completed work. Completing work generates the final bill from the agreed rate.
job.completedAcresHint: Use up to 3 decimal places, for example 2.5.
job.completedTripsHint: Enter a whole number of trips.
job.evidenceEmpty: No work has been recorded yet.
job.feedback.sequence: That action does not match the job's current state. Check the current state and valid next actions below.
job.feedback.conflict: The job changed at the same time. Review the current state below, then try again.
job.feedback.invalid: Check the completed quantity and try again.
job.feedback.failed: The action was not confirmed. Pressing it again retries the same request, so it cannot be recorded twice.
job.feedback.offline: The connection failed and nothing was queued. When you are online, press the same action again to retry safely.
job.loadError: Job details are unavailable right now. Refresh and retry safely.
job.farmerHelp: The Owner records start, pause, resume and completion. Paused time is not billed.
bill.title: Final bill
bill.previewHelp: The Farmer sees this bill. It uses the agreed price, not current catalog prices.
bill.notReady: The final bill is not ready yet. It is generated when work is completed.
bill.roundingNote: The amount is rounded once, to the nearest paisa.
bill.reissued: This bill replaces an earlier version after a work-record correction.
bill.reviewHelp: Check the work record and calculation. If the bill is correct, pay the Owner as agreed. If something is wrong, raise a dispute before paying.
bill.disputeReason: What is wrong with this bill?
bill.disputeHint: Describe the difference, for example the acres or time you expected.
bill.disputedHelp: Your dispute is recorded. The bill and work record are kept unchanged, and payment cannot be finalised until the dispute is reviewed.
bill.ownerDisputedHelp: The Farmer disputed this bill. Settlement is blocked until the dispute is reviewed.
bill.feedback.conflict: This booking changed before your dispute was saved. Review the latest bill and try again.
bill.feedback.invalid: Enter a reason for the dispute.
bill.feedback.failed: The dispute was not confirmed and nothing was queued. Check your connection and submit it again.
payment.title: Payment
payment.blocked: The bill is disputed. Payment cannot be recorded until the dispute is reviewed.
payment.noRecords: No payment has been recorded yet.
payment.testModeHelp: Test payment through the provider's sandbox. No real money moved.
payment.settledHelp: This bill is fully paid and the booking is complete.
payment.farmerHelp: Pay the Owner in cash as agreed. The Owner records the cash they receive, and it appears here.
payment.notBilled: Payment is due after the final bill is ready.
payment.cashHelp: Record only cash you have received in hand. You can record part of the bill now and the rest later.
payment.cashAmountHint: Up to {amount} can be recorded on this bill.
payment.cashReceivedAtHint: Leave empty if you received it just now. It cannot be in the future.
payment.cashRetryHelp: Check the payment records below first. If the {amount} payment is not listed, retry it. Retrying sends the same request, so it cannot be recorded twice.
payment.feedback.invalid: Check the amount and time. The amount must be more than ₹0 with at most two decimal places, and the time cannot be in the future. Nothing was recorded.
payment.feedback.overpayment: That amount is more than what remains on the bill. Nothing was recorded.
payment.feedback.blocked: The bill is disputed, so payment cannot be recorded until it is reviewed. Nothing was recorded.
payment.feedback.conflict: The bill or booking changed, so nothing was recorded. Review the latest payment details and try again.
payment.feedback.failed: The cash record was not confirmed and nothing was queued.
payment.feedback.offline: The connection failed and nothing was queued.
payment.receipt.unavailable: A receipt is available once the bill is fully paid.
payment.online.title: Pay online
payment.online.help: You will pay through the payment provider's secure window. The bill counts the money only after the provider confirms the payment to KisanTractor.
payment.online.unavailable: Online payment is not available right now. You can pay the Owner in cash.
payment.online.pendingHelp: {amount} is waiting for the payment provider's confirmation. Cash cannot be recorded for this amount until the payment is confirmed or cancelled.
payment.online.cancelHelp: Cancel only if you did not pay. We first ask the payment provider: a payment it has received or is still processing is never cancelled.
payment.online.notCompletedHelp: The last online payment was not completed, so no money was taken for it. You can try again or pay the Owner in cash.
payment.online.retryHelp: Check the payment records below first. Retrying sends the same request, so only one online payment is started.
payment.online.feedback.returned: Thank you. The payment is waiting for the payment provider's confirmation. Refresh or check its status in a moment.
payment.online.feedback.dismissed: The payment window was closed. If you did not pay, nothing was taken. You can continue the payment or cancel it.
payment.online.feedback.confirmed: The payment provider confirmed your online payment.
payment.online.feedback.cancelled: The online payment was cancelled. Nothing was taken, and the bill can be paid again.
payment.online.feedback.inProgress: The payment provider is still processing this payment, so it cannot be cancelled. Check its status again in a few minutes.
payment.online.feedback.unavailable: Online payment is not available right now. Nothing was started. You can pay the Owner in cash.
payment.online.feedback.invalid: The payment details were not valid. Nothing was started.
payment.online.feedback.overpayment: That amount is more than what remains on the bill. Nothing was started.
payment.online.feedback.blocked: The bill is disputed, so it cannot be paid until it is reviewed. Nothing was started.
payment.online.feedback.conflict: The bill or booking changed, so nothing was started. Review the latest payment details and try again.
payment.online.feedback.expired: The time to complete this payment has passed. Check its status, or cancel it and start again.
payment.online.feedback.review: This payment needs a check by support. Nothing was changed.
payment.online.feedback.failed: The online payment was not confirmed and nothing was queued.
payment.online.feedback.offline: The connection failed and nothing was queued.
payment.checkout.title: Complete your online payment
payment.checkout.authoritative: Your bill is marked paid only after the payment provider confirms the payment to KisanTractor. Closing this page does not cancel a payment you completed.
payment.checkout.attemptFailed: That attempt did not go through. You can try again in the payment window.
payment.checkout.windowUnavailable: The payment window could not be opened. Go back to the booking and try again later.
payment.checkout.expired: The time to complete this payment has passed. Go back to the booking to check its status.
payment.checkout.noScript: Online payment needs JavaScript in this browser. Go back to the booking to pay in cash.
payment.checkout.notFound: This payment is unavailable for this account.
payment.checkout.notPending: This online payment is no longer waiting to be paid. Go back to the booking to see its status.
payment.checkout.failed: The payment window could not be prepared. Nothing was paid. Go back to the booking and try again.
payment.history.intro: Every payment recorded on your bookings, newest first. Online payments count only after the payment provider confirms them.
payment.history.empty: No payments have been recorded yet.
payment.ownerPendingHelp: An online payment from the Farmer is waiting for the payment provider's confirmation. Cash for that amount can be recorded only if the online payment is cancelled or not completed.
connectivity.offline: You are offline. Information on this screen may be out of date. No booking, job, or payment action is sent until you are back online and press it again.
connectivity.online: You are back online. Nothing was sent automatically. Refresh to see the latest information, then retry any action yourself.
freshness.availability.fresh: Availability checked at {time}. A tractor is reserved only when the Owner accepts your booking.
freshness.availability.stale: Availability was checked at {time} and may have changed. Refresh before booking.
freshness.quote.fresh: Price estimate checked at {time}. The quote is fixed only when your booking is confirmed.
freshness.quote.stale: This price estimate was checked at {time} and may have changed. Refresh before confirming.
freshness.invoice.stale: This bill was checked at {time} and may have changed. Refresh to see the current bill.
freshness.payment.pending: Payment status checked at {time}. A payment is awaiting confirmation; refresh to check again.
freshness.payment.stale: Payment status was checked at {time} and may have changed. Refresh to see the current status.
freshness.offline: You are offline. This was last checked at {time} and may be out of date.
action.offlineBlocked: You are offline, so nothing was sent and nothing is waiting to be sent. Your entries are kept on this device. When you are back online, press “{action}” again. It reuses the same request, so it cannot be recorded twice.
action.unknownOutcome: Your last “{action}” may not have reached KisanTractor. Nothing was resent automatically. Check the current details on this page. If it is still needed, press “{action}” again; it reuses the same request, so it cannot be recorded twice.
action.draftRestored: Your saved entries were restored. Nothing has been sent yet.
booking.offline: You are offline, so the booking was not sent and nothing is waiting to be sent. Your draft is saved in this tab. When you are back online, press “{action}” again.
booking.unknown: We could not confirm whether your booking was received. Nothing was resent automatically. Press “{action}” to retry; it reuses the same request, so it cannot create a duplicate booking.
booking.unknownResumed: Your last booking confirmation may not have reached KisanTractor. Check My bookings, or press “{action}” to retry the same request; it cannot create a duplicate.
booking.conflict: This tractor or time is no longer available. Your draft is saved; refresh availability or choose another time or tractor.
booking.conflictAfterUnknown: An earlier confirmation may already have been received. Check My bookings before trying again.
booking.rejected: The booking could not be confirmed. Check the details and try again. Your draft is saved.
booking.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Log in again; your draft is saved in this tab.
booking.phoneNotSaved: For privacy, the coordination phone is not saved in drafts. Enter it again if you want the Owner to use it.
owner.bookings.decisionNotConfirmed: The decision was not confirmed and nothing was queued. Check the booking status below, then press Accept or Reject again if it is still needed. The booking version prevents a second decision.
notification.booking.requested: KisanTractor: New booking request {reference}. Open KisanTractor to accept or reject it.
notification.booking.accepted: KisanTractor: Your booking {reference} was accepted by the Owner.
notification.booking.rejected: KisanTractor: Your booking request {reference} was not accepted. You can search for another tractor.
notification.booking.expired: KisanTractor: Booking request {reference} expired because the Owner did not respond in time.
notification.bill.ready: KisanTractor: The final bill for booking {reference} is ready to view.
notification.payment.cashRecorded: KisanTractor: A cash payment for booking {reference} was recorded.
notification.booking.ownerContact: KisanTractor: The Owner for booking {reference} shared their number: {ownerPhone}.
notification.payment.onlineConfirmed: KisanTractor: Your online payment for booking {reference} is confirmed. The receipt is in your bookings.
notification.payment.onlineReceived: KisanTractor: An online payment for booking {reference} is confirmed.
notification.payment.onlineFailed: KisanTractor: The online payment for booking {reference} did not complete. You can try again or pay another way.
notification.payment.onlineReleased: KisanTractor: The pending online payment for booking {reference} was closed. You can pay again from your bookings.
notification.refund.requested: KisanTractor: A refund for booking {reference} was requested.
notification.refund.processed: KisanTractor: The refund for booking {reference} was processed by the payment provider.
notification.refund.failed: KisanTractor: The refund for booking {reference} could not be processed. Support will follow up.
landing.hero.title: Book a nearby tractor for your farm work
landing.hero.lead: Find registered tractor owners near your village, see the price before you book, and track the work until it is done.
landing.hero.imageAlt: A farmer with a towel over his shoulder looks across green crop rows at a green tractor in the field at sunset
landing.howItWorks.title: How it works
landing.howItWorks.step1.title: Tell us where and what
landing.howItWorks.step1.body: Choose your field location, the farming work, and the date and time you need.
landing.howItWorks.step2.title: Compare nearby tractors
landing.howItWorks.step2.body: See approximate distance, available equipment, and the owner's prices.
landing.howItWorks.step3.title: Book and get confirmation
landing.howItWorks.step3.body: Review the agreed price and send your request. The owner accepts before work starts.
landing.howItWorks.step4.title: Track work and pay
landing.howItWorks.step4.body: Follow the job, check the final bill against the agreed price, and record your payment.
landing.services.title: Farming services
landing.services.lead: Owners list the work their tractor and equipment can do.
landing.services.ploughing.title: Ploughing
landing.services.ploughing.body: Prepare the soil with ploughs and cultivators.
landing.services.rotavator.title: Rotavator tilling
landing.services.rotavator.body: Break clods and level the seedbed.
landing.services.sowing.title: Sowing and planting
landing.services.sowing.body: Seed drills and planters for timely sowing.
landing.services.harvesting.title: Harvesting
landing.services.harvesting.body: Harvest support for paddy, wheat, and other crops.
landing.services.transport.title: Trolley transport
landing.services.transport.body: Carry harvest, fodder, and farm inputs by trolley.
landing.services.levelling.title: Land levelling
landing.owner.title: Earn more with your tractor
landing.owner.lead: Register once and add every tractor you own.
landing.owner.benefit1.title: Choose when you are online
landing.owner.benefit1.body: Turn availability on or off for each tractor. Accepted work is always kept.
landing.owner.benefit2.title: Set your own prices
landing.owner.benefit2.body: Offer hourly, per-acre, or per-trip rates for each service.
landing.owner.benefit3.title: Accept the jobs you want
landing.owner.benefit3.body: Review booking requests before you commit.
landing.owner.benefit4.title: Clear bills and earnings
landing.owner.benefit4.body: Final bills follow the agreed rate and the recorded work.
landing.owner.imageAlt: A smiling farmer checks his mobile phone in a green field with a red tractor behind him
landing.pricing.title: Simple pricing methods
landing.pricing.lead: Every booking shows the pricing method and rate agreed before work starts.
landing.pricing.hourly.body: Pay for active working time. The rounding rule is shown before you book.
landing.pricing.perAcre.body: Pay for the area completed, measured in acres.
landing.pricing.perTrip.body: Pay a fixed rate for each trip, such as trolley transport.
landing.pricing.note: Rates are set by each tractor owner. The final bill is calculated from the agreed rate and the recorded work.
landing.phone.title: Booking by phone
landing.phone.unconfigured.label: Coming soon
landing.phone.unconfigured.message: Phone booking is not available yet. Please book online, or ask a family member to book for you.
landing.phone.sandbox.label: Being tested
landing.phone.sandbox.message: Phone booking is being tested and is not open to the public yet. Please book online.
landing.phone.degraded.label: Temporarily unavailable
landing.phone.degraded.message: Phone booking is temporarily unavailable. Please book online and try again later.
landing.phone.live.label: Available
landing.phone.live.message: Call the number below to book by phone in supported languages.
landing.languages.title: Use KisanTractor in your language
landing.languages.lead: Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Marathi, Bengali, and English are supported. You can change the language at any time.
landing.finalCta.title: Ready for your next farm job?
landing.finalCta.lead: Book a tractor as a farmer, or register your tractor and start receiving requests.
landing.footer.label: Site links
landing.footer.tagline: Tractor services for farmers and owners across India.
legal.pending: This document is being finalized and will be published here before launch.
dispute.title: Dispute review
dispute.outcome.UPHOLD: The bill was confirmed as issued
dispute.outcome.ADJUST: The bill was corrected to a new version
dispute.outcome.REFUND: A refund of the online payment was requested
dispute.outcome.CANCEL: The bill and booking were cancelled
dispute.holdHelp: Payment stays on hold until support finishes the review.
dispute.code.RATE_NOT_AGREED: Rate is not what was agreed
dispute.statementHint: Do not include phone numbers or addresses. Up to 500 characters.
dispute.feedback.added: Your statement was added to the review.
dispute.feedback.conflict: The review changed. Refresh and try again.
dispute.feedback.invalid: Check the statement and try again.
dispute.feedback.closed: This review is closed, so statements can no longer be added.
dispute.feedback.failed: The statement could not be sent and nothing was saved. Try again.
dispute.loadError: The dispute review could not be loaded.
support.title: Dispute cases
support.intro: You see only cases with an active, time-limited access grant. Every view and action is recorded.
support.casesEmpty: No dispute cases are assigned to you right now.
support.resolveHelp: Choose one outcome. Both parties are notified, and the booking follows the standard status rules.
support.resolution.CANCEL: Cancel the unpaid bill and booking
support.feedback.resolved: The dispute was resolved. Both parties will be notified.
support.feedback.conflict: The case or booking changed. Refresh and review it again.
support.feedback.invalid: This outcome is not allowed for the case right now.
support.feedback.denied: Your access to this case has ended or was not granted.
support.feedback.failed: The action could not be completed and nothing was changed. Try again.
support.loadError: Dispute cases could not be loaded.
notification.dispute.opened: KisanTractor: The bill for booking {reference} was disputed. Support will review it before payment is finalised.
notification.dispute.resolved: KisanTractor: The bill dispute for booking {reference} was resolved. Open KisanTractor to see the outcome.
